trust_decision.summary: Which external entities an uploaded import ZIP's manifest.xml (and imported legacy page content) may pull in is decided by the EntityResolver passed to CmsXmlUtils.unmarshalHelper; null means the parser's default resolution, CmsXmlEntityResolver means an allow-list (classpath DTD/XSD, opencms://, internal://) that throws for anything else.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'Import DB ... manifest.xml'; the per-version importData() parses the manifest with unmarshalHelper(..., null); V2-V5 share the identical line.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: matches()/getImportExportHandler() 'only sniff the version number before the real import, and load-external-dtd is already false', so a solver fixing the importData() parses argues the pre-checks are not the vulnerable import step.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate DTD/XSD references must still resolve: legacy xmlpage DTD, xmlpage XSD, the OpenCms default DTD prefix (import manifests' opencms-import.dtd) and opencms:// schemas; an over-broad fix (disallow-doctype-decl or no-entities in the shared unmarshalHelper) breaks these and every XML content/XML page parse that shares the helper.

legacy page body content from the ZIP (CmsXmlPageConverter)
